description.p: Experience the thrill of medieval castle building and destruction in our isometric, open source strategy game - a modern remake of Firefly Studios' classic Stronghold. Immerse yourself in a world of strategy and tactical decision making as you design and defend your own castles in medieval Europe.
Military units, new buildings, translations and more!
Here are some of the highlights of this version:

ul.li: Military units: Archers, spearmen, monks and more.
New buildings: Apothecary, pich rig and new wooden defensive structures.

description.p: This release contains many new features and bug fixes to make the experience more thrilling.
Here are some of the changes in this version:

ul.li: New Buildings: Dairy Farm, Hops Farm, Brewery, Inn, Armory, and more.
Campaign Mode: Engage in missions with objectives.
Auto Tax Feature: Automatic taxation based on population happiness.
Miscellaneous Enhancements: Smoother camera zoom, more sound effects, tooltips for built buildings, bug fixes, and optimizations.

description.p: First release of Stone Kingdoms on Flathub
